items.title: SBI Funds makes strong D-St debut, ends 6.3% above IPO price
items.description: SBI Funds Management debuted on the stock market at a premium price.  The company raised over ₹9,813 crore through its initial public offering.  SBI plans no further stake dilution in the asset management company.  The fund house is investing in new Alternative Investment Funds capabilities.  SBI Funds aims to expand its reach into B30 markets.

items.title: Stock Radar: Himadri Speciality stock hits fresh record high in July 2026; time to buy?
items.description: In July 2026, Himadri Speciality Chemical Ltd's stock soared to new heights, stirring excitement among investors. Experts urge buying the stock with a target set at 800. The stock has surged over 60% in the previous quarter and is currently positioned above pivotal moving averages.
